Name: AutoForager
Author: DebugDew
Description:
[center][b][size=6]✨ AutoForager ✨[/size][/b]
[size=4][i]The ultimate automation tool for your daily chores![/i][/size][/center]

[size=4]Tired of running around the map every day? Let [b]AutoForager[/b] do the hard work. It collects items automatically and puts them in your chests. Made for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+[/b].[/size]

[line]

[b][size=5]🌟 Core Features[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][b]Global Master Switch:[/b] Want to do things manually for a day? Easily turn the entire mod ON or OFF with a single click in the menu![/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Forage Collection:[/b] Collects wild plants, flowers and spring onions every morning ([i]Default: 06:10 AM[/i]).[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Smart Sorting (Sub-Chests):[/b] Don't want a messy main chest? Assign dedicated sub-chests for [i]Fruit & Berry[/i], [i]Mushrooms[/i] and [i]Beach[/i] items. If you don't set them, items safely fallback to your [i]Main Forage chest[/i]![/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Berry Harvesting & Custom Rules:[/b] Picks Salmonberries and Blackberries from bushes. Fully supports modded berries and custom schedules! You can add custom bush rules in the config file by defining the season, day range and Item ID.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Moss Harvesting:[/b] Cleans and collects moss from trees.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Artifact & Seed Spots:[/b] Digs up worm spots (artifacts) and seeds instantly.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Tree Shaking:[/b] Shakes trees to get your daily fruits and seeds.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Farm Cave Looting:[/b] Gets mushrooms or fruits from your farm cave.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Stealth Trash Raids:[/b] Checks town trash cans safely. Villagers will not see you, so you never lose friendship![/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Truffle Sweeper:[/b] Collects all truffles from your pigs in the evening ([i]Default: 05:00 PM[/i]).[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Custom Times:[/b] You can change the collection times in the mod menu.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Fair Play & Custom EXP:[/b] Earn Foraging XP from automated collections, or turn it OFF in the settings if you prefer vanilla balance! Your skills (Botanist/Gatherer) work perfectly, and the mod [i]NEVER[/i] steals quest items (like Robin's Axe).[/size][/*]
[/list][line]

[b][size=5]📦 How It Works & Setup[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][b]Connect Your Chests:[/b] Stand near a chest, press [b]J[/b] (default key), and assign its category (Forage, Trash, Truffles, etc.). The menu dynamically tracks your chests—if you accidentally break or move one, the menu will safely show it as "NOT SET"![/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Smart Map Tracking:[/b] The mod comes pre-loaded with default locations ([i]Farm, Bus Stop, Pelican Town, The Beach, The Mountain, Backwoods and Cindersap Forest[/i]). For any other new map, just walk into it! The mod learns it automatically. No codes needed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Turn Maps ON/OFF:[/b] Turn the mod ON or OFF for any specific map using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].[/size][/*]
[/list][line]

[b][size=5]🔌 Compatibility[/size][/b]

[size=4]Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. 100% works with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), Ridgeside Village and East Scarp[/b].
[i](It works perfectly with other map mods too, but their names might look a bit weird in the menu).[/i][/size]
